roles.label: Agent observer
roles.description: Release permitted machine inventory and resource readings to an approved agent.

roles.label: Observer
roles.description: Read assigned project resources, files, workspaces, and operation records.

roles.label: Managed operator
roles.description: Use assigned project capabilities. Job and terminal execution have full remote-account authority.

roles.label: Node administrator
roles.description: Invite, approve and revoke contributors within the assigned project.

roles.label: VM observer
roles.description: Read VM inventory and operation records on assigned systems. Console input and power actions are excluded.

roles.label: VM operator
roles.description: Inspect VMs, open interactive consoles and confirm power actions on assigned systems.

roles.label: Container operator
roles.description: Inspect workloads and logs, and confirm container lifecycle actions on assigned systems.

roles.label: System operator
roles.description: Inspect status and logs, and confirm service or system power actions on assigned systems.
